name: What permits are typically required for rental unit construction or renovation in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

mainEntity.name: What permits are typically required for rental unit construction or renovation in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex often require various permits, depending on the scope of work. Projects involving structural changes, electrical, plumbing, or significant layout modifications in a rental unit will typically need city permits. AKN Design Group manages the entire permit coordination process as part of our integrated design-build service, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured from concept to completion. This simplifies the process for property owners.
